description: This file implements security-related utilities for a FastAPI-based backend, specifically functions for authenticating and retrieving the current user based on a Bearer token, using dependencies on sqlmodel for database interaction and custom utility/error modules.

methods.name: User get_current_user(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="Authorization"))
methods.description: Async function that extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header, decodes it, validates its contents, and retrieves the corresponding user from the database, raising appropriate errors if validation fails.
